answer: Fixed-pool dilution bond. A 200,000-credit pool is posted on a zephyr ledger; each claimant burns 80 credits for one jade token bound to a key; falcon auditors divide the pool by jade tokens, and reuse under a second key voids it. With 2,000 honest claimants, one honest agent gets 100 credits, netting 20. A first fake also nets 20, but each added fake dilutes earlier fakes: the 1,000th adds only 44 against its 80 bond, and 1,000 fakes collect 66,667 against 80,000 burned, losing 13,333. A share-farming ring counts in the same total. The pool pays only audited holders.
